domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record found. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report splits could not be retrieved: web_search returned a backend error ("searx: Connection refused") on both attempts, Google returned HTTP 429, and Bing returned only unrelated YouTube results. Address on the customs record is "1ST FLOOR 316 PHASE 1 SECTOR 38 SONIPAT" (Haryana), but no GSTIN, turnover figure or domestic contract is public in the sources I could reach.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs rows with destination Nepal (Birgunj via Raxaul land port) and BOL number 8503284, latest 2026-01-06. Declared HS 392690 is broadly consistent with the observed HS 39269099 line (plastic lab consumables, Hitachi cup), but the same consignment also carries 84211100, 84199090, 90183990 and 90330000 — so the company ships a mixed laboratory/diagnostic consumables basket, not a single HS code; the declared code should be treated as one of several actual codes rather than corrected to a single value. Role reads as trader/distributor of lab consumables (multiple third-party brands: Hitachi, Gilson, SD Biosensor, Jaibro Diagnostics appear as counterparties), not a manufacturer. Domestic supply: no traces found in accessible public sources — status unknown, not 'conditionally accepted'; absence here reflects paywalled/unreachable registries, not a negative finding. Revenue and export volume: null — ImportKey shows shipment counts only, no values, and no financials are public. Note the near-identical name "CURENEXT SYSTEMS PVT LTD" returns an empty ImportKey page (no records), so the entity with shipments is the un-suffixed "CURENEXT SYSTEMS"; legal-form confirmation (CIN/PAN) is not public in the sources reached.
